entities.name: Bontu's Monument
entities.description: A legendary artifact and sacred site, a crocodile-head pyramid of alabaster and gold in Naktamun dedicated to Bontu, where the Trial of Ambition is held.

entities.name: Bontu
entities.description: God of Amonkhet whose doctrine holds that only sacrifice and betrayal bring glory.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: The plane on which Naktamun lies.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: City on Amonkhet containing Bontu's Monument.

entities.name: Samut
entities.description: Discovered a glyph in the monument and realized the truth about Amonkhet and the God-Pharaoh.

entities.name: The God-Pharaoh
entities.description: Revealed to be the destroyer of Amonkhet who altered the memory of the gods and the history of the plane.

entities.name: Oketra
entities.description: God whose trials teach cooperation and solidarity.

entities.name: Trial of Ambition
entities.description: The fourth trial held in Bontu's Monument in which ten initiates of a crop are made to compete.

entities.name: Trial of Zeal
entities.description: Final trial whose starting position depends on the door chosen in Bontu's Monument.

entities.name: Bontu's viziers
entities.description: Servants who inscribe the names of excelling initiates and collect and resell offerings.

events.summary: Samut discovers the Trespasser glyph in the monument and realizes the God-Pharaoh is the Great Trespasser and the destroyer of Amonkhet.
events.quote: Samut realized the God-Pharaoh was not a savior but the destroyer of the plane of Amonkhet.

events.summary: In the Trial of Ambition, initiates move through trap-filled chambers, sacrificing each other to cross a snake-filled pool.
events.quote: ten members of a crop would enter the monument, where they were made to compete rather than cooperate.

events.summary: In the final chamber Bontu tells the remaining initiates of three doors that determine their starting position in the Trial of Zeal while scarab beetles swarm in.
events.quote: Bontu informed the remaining initiates that there were three doors

relations.quote: a legendary artifact and sacred site dedicated to the god Bontu

relations.note: In the Desert of the Glorified in Naktamun
relations.quote: located in the Desert of the Glorified in the city of Naktamun
